# KACISTUDIO

> A Singapore-based Gen Z social media agency that helps brands tell their story with intention.

KACISTUDIO is a story-first social media agency founded in 2025 by Angeline Khor and Jovinna Chow. We work with a small roster of lifestyle, beauty, and wellness brands — two new brands per quarter, max — so the attention never gets diluted. Founder-led by Gen Z creatives who live on TikTok and Instagram, we handle strategy, production, community, and events as one continuous rhythm. Singapore-based, working with global clients.

## Services

- [Social Media Management](https://kacistudio.co/services#service-tab-smm): Studio supports one platform with 6 videos and 4 graphics; Atelier supports two platforms with 10 videos and 6 graphics; Maison supports two to three platforms with 14 videos and 10 graphics. Packages include planning, captions, publishing, community management, and monthly insights. Bespoke scopes are available.
- [Content Creation](https://kacistudio.co/services#service-tab-content): A La Carte offers a tailored number of videos for campaigns, launches, or content refreshes. The Set bundles videos planned and produced together.
- [Event Branding and Marketing](https://kacistudio.co/services#service-tab-branding): Creative concept, naming, visual direction, event assets, and marketing content for launches, pop-ups, and activations.

## Selected Work

- [Resurrack × LittleMissMarket](https://kacistudio.co/case-resurrack-littlemissmarket): Lifestyle co-brand collab across TikTok and Instagram. Narrative built around a "weekend ritual" rather than a product push. Results updating. (2025)
- [Flyco](https://kacistudio.co/case-flyco): Customisable luggage brand. Blackpink concert campaign using BLINK fan culture language. Result: 23K+ campaign video views. (2025)
- [Brixx Derma](https://kacistudio.co/case-brixx-derma): Derm-led skincare brand. Rebuilt social around nightly-routine TikToks and ingredient storytelling. Result: 30K+ Instagram views (73% new audiences), +500% TikTok view growth, +1,700% TikTok likes growth. (2026)
- [Melissa Shoes](https://kacistudio.co/case-melissa-shoes): Fashion brand. Motion-first campaign connecting Gen Z and millennials. Result: 10K+ views across campaigns, 900%+ audience interaction uplift. (2025)
- [Coffeeman@NYP](https://kacistudio.co/case-coffeeman-nyp): F&B new menu launch. Intimate, warm content that let the food speak. Result: 1K+ views per video, 92% new audiences reached. (2025)
- [Happy Rei](https://kacistudio.co/case-happy-rei): Kids' lifestyle brand. Reel built around children choosing and rating their own favourites — proof through everyday affection rather than a catalogue pitch. Results updating.
- [Luminance Learning](https://kacistudio.co/case-luminance-learning): Math tuition brand. 60-second Q&A shaped around the confidence and reassurance questions families quietly carry. Results updating.
- [Fine Today Singapore (FINO)](https://kacistudio.co/case-fino): Japanese haircare brand. UGC-led content introducing FINO in a relatable, Gen Z-friendly, lifestyle-driven way across the SEA market. Results updating.

## Key Facts

- Based in Singapore
- Founded 2025
- Founders: Angeline Khor (content ideation, aesthetic curation), Jovinna Chow (shoot production, campaign execution)
- Hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00 SGT
- Response time: within 2 business days
- Commitment: month-to-month, no lock-in contracts
- Capacity: two new brands per quarter, max
- Agency stats: 8 client case studies, 500%+ TikTok growth on flagship campaigns
- Platforms managed: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Lemon8, Xiaohongshu, Telegram

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I pick and choose deliverables?** We offer custom packages based on your brand's needs. Whether you need full-scope management or support in specific areas, we'll shape the scope around what feels most aligned for this season.

**Do you work with brands outside Singapore?** Yes — Singapore-based, but clients are global. Shoot days happen in SG; strategy, editing, management, and community work asynchronously across time zones.

**How long is the commitment?** Month-to-month. Every cycle ends with a review — you decide if it feels right to continue.

**Who owns the content?** You do. All raw footage, edits, photography, and brand assets are yours to keep, use, and repurpose — forever.
